(DEFUN JAVA-LINK-CANDIDATES (&KEY ORIGIN PANEL-SITE ITEM-SITE JOURNAL-SITES)
  Panel.load(Panel from, String slug), Main.java L225-L255: the origin first, then the item's site, then the panel
context. Returns ((SITE . SOURCE) ...) in request order; SOURCE is :ORIGIN, :ITEM, :PANEL or :JOURNAL, the reason for
the position. The origin is not removed from the context, so it can occur twice (observed: origin-in-context).
  (LET ((CONTEXT (JAVA-PANEL-CONTEXT PANEL-SITE ORIGIN JOURNAL-SITES)))
    (WHEN ITEM-SITE

    (CONS (CONS ORIGIN ORIGIN)
          (MAPCAR
           (LAMBDA (SITE)
             (CONS SITE

                         ((AND (EQUAL SITE PANEL-SITE)
                               (NOT (EQUAL PANEL-SITE ORIGIN)))
                          PANEL)
                         (T JOURNAL))))
           CONTEXT))))

(DEFUN PLAN-LINK-RESOLUTION
       (STATE TASKS
        &KEY (DOMAIN 'FEDWIKI-LINK-RESOLUTION)
        (NAME (GENSYM LINK-RESOLUTION-)))
  Search all plans with real SHOP3 and return the existing HYPERDOC-HTN-PLAN-RESULT (:PLAN-ONLY).
The problem is registered only for the search and SHOP3:*PROBLEM* is restored. The pinned SHOP3 (ce53f9b) cannot
build a plan tree for a plan with no step (STRIP-TREE-TAGS: NIL is not of type CONS); for that case the search is
repeated without trees and each tree is (:PLAN-TREE-UNAVAILABLE :SHOP3-EMPTY-PLAN-DEFECT), so the four lists stay parallel.
  (LET ((*PROBLEM* *PROBLEM*))
    (MAKE-PROBLEM (LIST NAME DOMAIN DOMAIN SILENTLY T) (COPY-TREE STATE)
                  (COPY-TREE TASKS))
    (UNWIND-PROTECT
        (MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND (RAW SECONDS TREES STATES)
            (HANDLER-CASE
             (FIND-PLANS NAME WHICH ALL VERBOSE 0 PLAN-TREE T COLLECT-STATE T)
             (TYPE-ERROR (CONDITION)
              (MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND (RAW SECONDS TREES STATES)
                  (FIND-PLANS NAME WHICH ALL VERBOSE 0 PLAN-TREE NIL
                              COLLECT-STATE T)
                (DECLARE (IGNORE TREES))
                (UNLESS (MEMBER NIL RAW) (ERROR CONDITION))
                (VALUES RAW SECONDS
                        (MAPCAR
                         (CONSTANTLY
                          '(PLAN-TREE-UNAVAILABLE SHOP3-EMPTY-PLAN-DEFECT))
                         RAW)
                        STATES))))
          (MAKE-INSTANCE 'HYPERDOC-HTN-PLAN-RESULT PROBLEM-NAME NAME RAW-PLANS
                         RAW PLANS (MAPCAR #'SHORTER-PLAN RAW) TIME SECONDS
                         PLAN-TREES TREES FINAL-STATES STATES EXECUTION-MODE
                         PLAN-ONLY))
      (DELETE-PROBLEM NAME))))

(DEFUN PLAN-OUTCOMES (RESULT STATE)
  One reading per plan: the outcome, the planned requests in order, and the simulated facts it adds.
Outcomes: :LOCAL-OBSERVED, :REMOTE-CONTEXT, :MODELED-LOCAL (hypothetical), :NOT-FOUND, :ABORTED-NETWORK-ERROR,
:FORK-PLANNED, :ALREADY-LOCAL-OBSERVED, :ALREADY-MODELED-LOCAL. No plan at all is reported by DIAGNOSE-NO-PLAN.
  (LET ((OWN (%OWN-SITE STATE)))
    (LOOP FOR PLAN IN (PLANS-OF RESULT)
          FOR FINAL IN (FINAL-STATES-OF RESULT)
          FOR ATOMS = (STATE-ATOMS FINAL)
          COLLECT (LET* ((STEPS (MAPCAR #'FIRST PLAN))
                         (OPEN (FIND '!OPEN-PANEL PLAN KEY #'FIRST)))
                    (LIST OUTCOME
                          (COND
                           ((MEMBER '!ABORT-RESOLUTION STEPS)
                            ABORTED-NETWORK-ERROR)
                           ((MEMBER '!CONCLUDE-UNRESOLVED STEPS) NOT-FOUND)
                           ((MEMBER '!USE-MODELED-PAGE STEPS) MODELED-LOCAL)
                           (OPEN
                            (IF (EQ (THIRD OPEN) OWN)
                                LOCAL-OBSERVED
                                REMOTE-CONTEXT))
                           ((MEMBER '!PLAN-FORK STEPS) FORK-PLANNED)
                           ((FIND `(PAGE-AVAILABLE ,OWN) ATOMS TEST
                                  (LAMBDA (P A)
                                    (EQUAL P (SUBSEQ A 0 (MIN 2 (LENGTH A))))))
                            ALREADY-LOCAL-OBSERVED)
                           (T ALREADY-MODELED-LOCAL))
                          REQUESTS
                          (LOOP FOR STEP IN PLAN
                                WHEN (EQ (FIRST STEP) '!REQUEST)
                                COLLECT (LIST (THIRD STEP) (FOURTH STEP)))
                          RESOLVED-AT (AND OPEN (THIRD OPEN)) STEPS STEPS
                          SIMULATED
                          (SET-DIFFERENCE ATOMS STATE TEST #'EQUAL))))))

(DEFUN CHECK-JAVA-AGREEMENT (&KEY (DOMAIN *DOMAIN*) QUIET)
  For every scenario: the planned page requests, in order, are the requests the Java servers received (after the
initial load of the origin's welcome page, and except for a 'dead' site, which cannot log), and each link's outcome
is the Java outcome: the lineup site, 'can't find page in current context', or 'http error'.
  (LET ((OBSERVATIONS (LOAD-OBSERVATIONS)))
    (ASSERT OBSERVATIONS NIL
            observed.json is missing: run tests/fedwiki-java-reference/run-reference.py)
    (ASSERT
     (EQUAL +REFERENCE-REVISION+
            (GETHASH revision (GETHASH reference OBSERVATIONS))))
    (DOLIST (SCENARIO (LOAD-SCENARIOS) T)
      (LET* ((ID (GETHASH id SCENARIO))
             (OBSERVED
              (FIND ID (COERCE (GETHASH scenarios OBSERVATIONS) 'LIST) KEY
                    (LAMBDA (S) (GETHASH id S)) TEST #'EQUAL))
             (DEAD
              (MAPCAR #'%K (COERCE (OR (GETHASH dead SCENARIO) #()) 'LIST)))
             (JAVA-REQUESTS
              (MAP 'LIST (LAMBDA (R) (LIST (%K (ELT R 0)) (%K (ELT R 1))))
                   (GETHASH page_requests OBSERVED)))
             (LINEUP
              (MAP 'LIST (LAMBDA (ENTRY) (%K (ELT ENTRY 1)))
                   (GETHASH lineup OBSERVED)))
             (TROUBLE (COERCE (GETHASH trouble OBSERVED) 'LIST))
             (PLANNED (LIST (LIST ORIGIN WELCOME-VISITORS)))
             (OUTCOMES 'NIL))
        (DOTIMES (I (LENGTH (GETHASH links SCENARIO)))
          (MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND (RESULT STATE)
              (SCENARIO-PLAN ID I DOMAIN DOMAIN)
            (LET ((OUTCOME (ONLY (PLAN-OUTCOMES RESULT STATE))))
              (PUSH OUTCOME OUTCOMES)
              (SETF PLANNED (APPEND PLANNED (GETF OUTCOME REQUESTS))))))
        (SETF OUTCOMES (NREVERSE OUTCOMES))
        (LET ((LOGGABLE
               (REMOVE-IF (LAMBDA (REQUEST) (MEMBER (FIRST REQUEST) DEAD))
                          PLANNED)))
          (ASSERT (EQUAL LOGGABLE JAVA-REQUESTS) NIL
                  ~A: planned ~S, Java requested ~S ID LOGGABLE JAVA-REQUESTS))
        (COND
         ((NULL TROUBLE) (ASSERT (ZEROP (GETHASH exit_code OBSERVED)))
          (ASSERT
           (EQUAL (MAPCAR (LAMBDA (O) (GETF O RESOLVED-AT)) OUTCOMES)
                  (REST LINEUP))
           NIL ~A: resolved at ~S, Java lineup ~S ID
           (MAPCAR (LAMBDA (O) (GETF O RESOLVED-AT)) OUTCOMES) LINEUP))
         ((SEARCH can't find page (FIRST TROUBLE))
          (ASSERT (EQ NOT-FOUND (GETF (CAR (LAST OUTCOMES)) OUTCOME)) NIL
                  ~A: ~S ID OUTCOMES))
         ((SEARCH http error (FIRST TROUBLE))
          (ASSERT
           (EQ ABORTED-NETWORK-ERROR (GETF (CAR (LAST OUTCOMES)) OUTCOME)) NIL
           ~A: ~S ID OUTCOMES))
         (T (ERROR ~A: unexpected Java trouble ~S ID TROUBLE)))
        (UNLESS QUIET
          (PASS (FORMAT NIL JAVA ~A ID) ~D page requests as Java; outcomes ~S
                (LENGTH JAVA-REQUESTS)
                (MAPCAR (LAMBDA (O) (GETF O OUTCOME)) OUTCOMES)))))))
